title: Disruption triage + recovery routing
description: Score live supply exceptions by downstream impact, cut a queue that fits the shift, and route the top band to a costed recovery decision.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-supply-02
  title: Disruption triage + recovery routing
  description: Score live supply exceptions by downstream impact, cut a queue that fits the shift, and
    route the top band to a costed recovery decision.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Turn an undifferentiated exception feed into a ranked, capacity-sized action queue with an
    explicit escalation path for exceptions that will stop production.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Live exception feed
      summary: Live exception feed
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - exception_events
              - production_schedule
              - customer_commitments
              - shift_capacity
            properties:
              exception_events: {}
              production_schedule: {}
              customer_commitments: {}
              shift_capacity: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n-classify
      kind: agent
      templateRef: supply-05
      name: Score exceptions by downstream impact
      summary: Score and label every incoming item before anything is queued.
      role: Control-tower operator triaging in-flight shipment and supply exceptions.
      prompt: You are a Logistics Exception Controller. You classify live exceptions — delay, damage,
        short-ship, customs hold, capacity failure — by downstream production or customer impact rather
        than by how alarming the alert text sounds, and you propose the specific recovery action with
        its cost. You state what will break and when if nothing is done, because an exception without
        a deadline gets treated as background noise.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - incident-response
          - clinical-review
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:tms
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - label
          - severity
          - confidence
          - rationale
        properties:
          label: {}
          severity: {}
          confidence: {}
          rationale: {}
    - id: n-filter
      kind: transform
      name: Drop out-of-scope items
      summary: keep exceptions whose impact touches a committed order or a scheduled production run
      config:
        operation: filter
        expression: keep exceptions whose impact touches a committed order or a scheduled production run
    - id: n-rank
      kind: transform
      name: Rank by urgency
      summary: sort by hours_until_impact ascending, then by committed_revenue descending
      config:
        operation: sort
        expression: sort by hours_until_impact ascending, then by committed_revenue descending
    - id: n-queue
      kind: transform
      name: Cut the actionable queue
      summary: take the first shift_capacity items as the actionable queue
      config:
        operation: slice
        expression: take the first shift_capacity items as the actionable queue
    - id: n-severity
      kind: condition
      name: Severity routing
      summary: Route on queue_item.severity selects one declared branch.
      config:
        expression: queue_item.severity selects one declared branch
        branches:
          - label: Escalate
            when: escalate
          - label: Standard
            when: standard
          - label: Default
            when: default
    - id: n-escalate
      kind: agent
      templateRef: supply-03
      name: Costed recovery options for line-down risk
      summary: Escalation path for the top band.
      role: Logistics engineer optimizing routing, load building, and network flow under real constraints.
      prompt: You are a Network & Route Optimizer. You formulate routing and network-flow problems with
        their real constraints — vehicle capacity, driver hours, time windows, dock capacity, cross-dock
        timing — and report the objective value with its optimality gap. You never present a heuristic
        solution as provably optimal, and you name which constraint is binding so a planner knows what
        to relax to get a better answer.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - optimization
          - simulation
          - domain-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:tms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-handle
      kind: agent
      templateRef: supply-02
      name: Standard carrier and inventory recovery
      summary: Standard resolution path.
      role: Inventory planner setting safety stock, reorder points, and service-level policy.
      prompt: You are an Inventory Policy Planner. You translate a demand distribution and a lead-time
        distribution into reorder points, safety stock, and order quantities against an explicit service-level
        target, and you show which input drives each number. You state the cost of the service level you
        are buying rather than presenting a policy as if it were free, and you flag items where lead-time
        variance, not demand variance, is the binding problem.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - optimization
          - simulation
          - decision-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-rejoin
      kind: join
      name: Reconverge after routing
      summary: Release whichever routed path completed.
      config:
        join: first
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Control tower lead approves spend-bearing recovery actions
      summary: Pause for the control tower lead; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Disruption triage + recovery routing deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-classify
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-2
      from: n-classify
      to: n-filter
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-3
      from: n-filter
      to: n-rank
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-4
      from: n-rank
      to: n-queue
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-5
      from: n-queue
      to: n-severity
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-6
      from: n-severity
      to: n-escalate
      kind: control
      condition: escalate
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-7
      from: n-severity
      to: n-handle
      kind: control
      condition: standard
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-8
      from: n-escalate
      to: n-rejoin
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-9
      from: n-handle
      to: n-rejoin
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-10
      from: n-rejoin
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-02-edge-11
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
